scheme_name: Funeral Assistance for the Construction Worker
other_conditions: Must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must be a nominee or dependent of a registered worker of the Sikkim Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Nominee/dependent must have lost the registered member/worker due to death
benefits_summary: Provides a funeral assistance of ₹10,000 to eligible nominees/dependents.
